description: READ a shader note from the Obsidian vault (a ```glsl fragment block, optional ```glslvert vertex block, and optional `uniforms`/`resolution`/`name` frontmatter) and CREATE a GLSL TOP in TouchDesigner from it. Side effect is node creation in TD, not file writes. Use this to apply a shader you keep in the vault; to supply shader code inline instead, use create_glsl_shader. Returns the created GLSL TOP (same result as create_glsl_shader). Requires a configured TDMCP_VAULT_PATH, TDMCP_RAW_PYTHON=on, and TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=1.

name.description: Name for the GLSL TOP (defaults to the note's frontmatter `name`, else 'glsl1').

note.description: Shader note: a vault-relative path, or a name resolved against the Shaders/ folder.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP to create the GLSL TOP inside.

name: apply_shader_from_vault
title: Apply a GLSL shader from the vault
